此子，断不可留！（此子，断不可留！（第22页）然而，据他所知，萧家最顶级的功法，也不过是玄阶中级的狂狮怒罡而已。但萧炎的斗气，似乎是火属性。萧家什么时候有的玄阶中级火属性功法？不论如何，此子的天赋，未来很可能会是斗王级别的强者，届时，他们加列家能否活着离开乌坦城，都是个问题！因此，此子，断不可留！“加列家主看起来有些烦恼啊。”苍老的声音中，带着几分淡淡的笑意。“前辈！？”听到那心心念念的熟悉声音，加列毕满脸都是喜悦之色，“太好了，您来了，我这一颗心可就算是放下了。”“上次问你要炼制什么丹药，你说想要考虑一下，现在考虑的如何？”药老的声音淡然响起。“前辈，晚辈想要求前辈炼制几瓶筑基灵液给我那不成器的儿子！”加列毕原本是想要请药老炼制一些适合自己提升实力的丹药，但加列奥这几日的表现，让他不得不选择了筑基灵液。他当然知道，米特尔拍卖行不可能只卖那么五瓶筑基灵液，以后肯定还有。但是数万金币只能买到一瓶灵液，即便他是加列家的家主，也不可能这样肆无忌惮的消耗家族的资金。因此，也只好求前辈炼制一些筑基灵液了。“唔，可以，这是三瓶筑基灵液，售卖的价格，完全可以覆盖我之前从你这里取用的那一批药材的总价值。”药老没怎么犹豫，便是直接取出三个玉瓶，将其递给了加列毕。“老夫还有事，便先走一步了。”说罢，萧炎便是推门离去。“前辈稍等！”加列毕本想跟神秘的炼药师前辈再拉近一些关系，然而，当他追出门的时候，却是发现，院子里，竟然是空无一人。“这等神出鬼没的手段，恐怕至少也是斗灵级别了吧？”加列毕脸色一变，有些黯然地摇摇头。看来，只能等下一次了。“啧，一挥手给出去十万多金币，真是肉疼啊！”走在前往米特尔拍卖行的路上，萧炎有些痛心地说道。“据我所知，加列家和你们萧家，一直都不对付，你之前还跟我说把他儿子打了一顿，嘿嘿，你觉得我是那种资敌的人吗？”药老发出一阵怪笑，戏谑道。“嗯？”萧炎闻言这才回过神来，旋即检查了一下纳戒，发现五十瓶筑基灵液，一瓶都没少？“刚才给他的，不过是一些残余的边角料的药材所炼化出来的灵液，效果自然是有的，但肯定比不上这些，三瓶加起来，成本连一千金币都不到，有什么好心疼的？”药老笑眯眯地说道。“老师，我一直觉得我已经很阴了，没想到您也比我还更甚一筹！”闻言，萧炎摇摇头，有些哭笑不得地说道。“混账小子，哪有这么说自己老师的！”药老笑骂道。

Chapter 19 This child must not be kept (Page 1)
This child must not be kept! (This son must not be kept! (Page 22) However, as far as he knows, the Xiao family's top-level Kung Fu is only the Xuan-level intermediate Mad Lion Fury Gang. But Xiao Yan's fighting spirit seems to be of the fire attribute. When did the Xiao family have the Xuan-level intermediate fire-attribute Kung Fu? In any case, this son's talent will probably make him a Dou Wang-level powerhouse in the future. By then, will the Jialie family be able to leave Wu alive? Tancheng is a problem! Therefore, this son must not be kept! "The head of the Jialie family looks a little worried." There was a faint smile in the old voice. "Senior!?" Hearing the familiar voice that he was thinking about, Jialiebi's face was full of joy, "Great, you are here, I am relieved." "Last time, I asked you what pill you want to refine. "I want to think about it, what are you thinking about now?" Yao Lao's voice sounded calmly. "Senior, I want to ask senior to refine a few bottles of foundation-building spiritual liquid for my incompetent son!" Jia Liebi originally wanted to ask Yao Lao to refine some elixirs suitable for improving his strength, but Galeo's performance in the past few days forced him to choose foundation-building spiritual liquid. Of course he knew that the Miter Auction House was not allowed. If you can only sell five bottles of foundation-building spiritual liquid, you will definitely have more in the future. However, tens of thousands of gold coins can only buy one bottle of spiritual liquid. Even if he is the head of the Jialie family, he cannot waste the family's funds so unscrupulously. Therefore, he has no choice but to ask his senior to refine some foundation-building spiritual liquid. The price of these three bottles of foundation-building spiritual liquid can completely cover the one I took from you before. The total value of the batch of medicinal materials." Yao Lao took out three jade bottles and handed them to Jia Liebi. "I have something to do, so I will take a step forward." After that, Xiao Yan opened the door and left. "Senior, wait a moment!" Jia Liebi wanted to get closer to the mysterious alchemist senior, but when he chased him out, he found that there was no one in the yard. "Isn't this mysterious method at least at the level of a fighting spirit?" Jialiebi's expression changed and he shook his head sadly. "Tsk, it's really painful to give out more than 100,000 gold coins with a wave of hands!" Xiao Yan said with some sadness while walking on the way to the Miter Auction House. "As far as I know, the Jialie family and your Xiao family have never dealt with it. , you told me to beat up his son before, hey, do you think I am the kind of person who wants to be an enemy?" Yao Lao laughed strangely and said jokingly. "Huh?" Hearing this, Xiao Yan came back to his senses and immediately checked the Najie and found that there were fifty bottles of foundation-building spiritual liquid, and none of them were missing? "What I gave him just now was the spiritual liquid refined from some leftover medicinal materials. The effect is natural. There are some, but they are definitely not as good as these. The total cost of three bottles is less than one thousand gold coins. What's there to feel bad about?" Yao Lao said with a smile. "Teacher, I always thought that I was very shady, but I didn't expect that you are even better than me!" Hearing this, Xiao Yan shook his head and said with a bit of laughter. "You bastard, how could you say that about your teacher?" Yao Lao said with a smile.
